args.body: SHOPIFY-COMMUNITY-DEMAND concluded STOP with two qualifying requests, below the predefined five-request threshold. Park catalogue-transformation: no further searches, speculative offer publication or implementation. Preserve its useful memo. Existing CSV and welfare windows remain open; three unclassified feedback sources do not establish zero demand. New effort is assigned to ACQUISITION for a bounded check of existing inbound routing and delivery context, without reading private mail or claiming classification occurred.

description: Shopify’s bounded test found only two qualifying requests against its five-request threshold, so no new offer will launch. Commercial feedback still has three unclassified sources; this does not establish zero demand. Next, make existing inbound experiments easier to distinguish without exposing correspondence or adding inventory.
